slides.title: How old are they?
items: I set the format and the shapes
Up to under 11s, everyone gets a go
slides.alt: How old are they? Pick the age group and Gafferboard sets the format and the shapes. Up to under 11s everyone gets a go, from under 12s it's about results.

slides.title: Squad in. Then we talk.
slides.body: Paste the names from the parents' group. Once.
slides.alt: The squad list on Gafferboard with numbers and positions.

slides.title: Pick your strongest side.
slides.body: Tap a shape. Drag players. I'll question it.
slides.alt: A 4-3-3 on the Gafferboard pitch with eleven players placed.

slides.title: Clock on. Make your changes.
slides.body: Every sub logged to the minute.
slides.alt: A coach on a floodlit touchline checks the match clock on a phone while the team plays.

slides.title: Send it to the *parents*.
slides.body: Who's in goes to the WhatsApp group, in your name. Never the shape. Never who's injured.
slides.alt: Send it to the parents. Who's in goes to the WhatsApp group in your name, never the shape or who's injured.
